malfunctionassessment.fault-code: FUEL IDG 1 COOL FAULT;FUEL IDG 2 COOL FAULT

cond-routing.intro: When the alert FUEL IDG 1(2) COOL FAULT is triggered, the Fuel Return Valve is inhibited in the closed position. As a consequence, it must be considered as inoperative in the closed position.

duref.linktext: Item 73-10-01A Fuel Return Valve - Inoperative in closed position
